subject: MedSyst evaluation: environment provisioning & MAP
messages:
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@medsyst.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MedSyst evaluation: environment provisioning & MAP

Hi Mateo,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profile and the cost controls. We're aiming to run a two-week evaluation next month and want to confirm the environment steps so we can sign off on the MAP and lock a target close date. Primary items for our infra team:

- org setup (enterprise org, user invites)
- API keys / scoped service accounts for read-only vs eval writes
- IP allowlist for our staging CIDR (10.12.0.0/20)
- VPC peering (AWS account: 987654321) with peering route table expectations

Can you share a short mutual action plan with ownership and deadlines? Our goal is to start provisioning the week of Aug 17 and begin evaluation Aug 24. If you can attach a one-page MAP and the network connector checklist that would be great.

Attaching our initial network diagram for context.

Thanks,
Anna
Anna Lopez
Head of IT Operations, MedSyst
anna.lopez@medsyst.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@medsyst.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, soojin_lee@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedSyst evaluation: environment provisioning & MAP

Anna — really appreciate the clear goals. Draft MAP attached (MedSyst_MAP_v0.3.xlsx) and below is a condensed action list that mirrors what we'll put in the sheet. I've added owners and recommended target dates so we can align on the Aug 24 evaluation start.

Condensed MAP (owners & targets):
- Redwood: create evaluation org & invite core users — owner: mateo_alvarez — target: 2026-08-10
- MedSyst: confirm staging CIDR and peering contact — owner: Anna Lopez / IT Ops — target: 2026-08-11
- Redwood: provision scoped API key (eval-write) + scoped read key for observability — owner: soojin_lee — target: 2026-08-13
- MedSyst: add Redwood public egress IPs to allowlist — owner: IT Ops — target: 2026-08-14
- Joint: schedule peering test and route validation (redwood infra + medsyst netops) — owner: karthik_iyer (coord) — target: 2026-08-17
- Joint: run smoke eval runbook and token rotation check — owner: MedSyst SRE / Redwood CS — target: 2026-08-21

Notes / constraints:
- For VPC peering we use standard cross-account peering; we will not request transitive routing. If MedSyst needs a transit setup, flag now.
- API keys: we recommend two keys (scoped): one with generation quotas for the eval agents, one read-only for metrics ingestion. We'll provide key rotation instructions.
- IP allowlist: we'll provide a short list of four egress IPs; recommend you only open required ports 443 and 22 for bastion tests.

I'll upload the MAP spreadsheet and a short peering checklist to the Drive link and add a one-page network playbook. If the dates above look good I'll turn the spreadsheet into a Jira board for task tracking.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Attachment: MedSyst_MAP_v0.3.xlsx
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedSyst evaluation: environment provisioning & MAP

Thanks — quick operational points from my side so we don't hit delays: 

- Anna: please share the AWS account ID and the exact peering contact (name/email) so we can schedule an initial 30-min pairing with our infra engineer.
- Anna: confirm whether you'll accept inbound traffic to a specific internal subnet or prefer to test via a hop/bastion. If in doubt, we'll set up a short bastion test first.
- Mateo/Soojin: please include the exact JSON snippet for the security-group ACL and the CIDR entries we should ask MedSyst to add (makes it easier for their NOC to copy/paste).

I'll block 30 minutes on Aug 17 for the peering test; if Anna's team prefers another slot, we can move.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Sales Engineering — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Anna Lopez <anna.lopez@medsyst.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: IT Ops <it-ops@medsyst.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Aug 2026 16:24:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedSyst evaluation: environment provisioning & MAP

All — thanks for the quick turnaround and the draft MAP. Confirming:

- AWS account: 987654321 (peering contact: Daniel Park, daniel.park@medsyst.com)
- Staging CIDR: 10.12.0.0/20 (will open for your four egress IPs)
- We'll accept peering to the specified subnet; we'll do a bastion test first and then open routes if all good.
- Timeline looks fine — MedSyst commits to the Aug 14 allowlist update and Aug 17 peering test.

Please share the SG/ACL JSON and the API key rotation doc; we'll ask our NOC to stand by on Aug 17 10:00 PT.

Looking forward to the test — once we pass we can proceed to the Aug 24 evaluation start.

Cheers,
Anna
